_contract.run: What the run did and how much of the market it read. session is the session the bars describe; expected_session is the session the run set out to read (they differ only on a closed day, when session is the previous one). status ok means every stage finished; degraded means it published with a problem listed in problems; closed means the market held no session; failed means nothing below is a verdict. problems carry one of seven kinds and never free text the page must render.
_contract.nights: The last twenty evenings, newest last: session, status, published_at. A session absent from the ring was never published for.
_contract.account: The account every plan is sized for, from the environment: equity, risk per trade in percent, the position cap in percent, and the slot cap.
_contract.rules: Every constant the run applied, keyed by module. The page prints these; it never restates one.
_contract.cover: The verdict as sentences: h1, dek, and the one action the page offers. Generated by the pipeline from the regime and the trade count; the page renders them verbatim.
_contract.breadth: Bonde's Market Monitor over every common stock that printed: today's counts, the 5- and 10-session ratios with their sums, the regime with its reasons verbatim and the scaled thresholds it compared, the last 30 sessions, and notes carrying his readings.
_contract.bursts: Every 4% or dollar breakout the scan found, graded on the nine A-quality criteria. quality is the checklist alone; claude is the chart read, null when none was asked for; grade is the final word after the clamp (Claude may only lower it). plan is present for A and A+ bursts and null otherwise. series carries the last 120 bars for trades and the closest miss only.
_contract.trades: Tickers with a final grade of A or A+, ranked, not vetoed, plan eligible, regime not red. The first slots get order lines; the rest are beyond_cap.
_contract.beyond_cap: Trades that qualified after the open slots were filled. A card, no order line.
_contract.cash_budget: What tomorrow's orders commit, the slots they use, and what was cut and why.
_contract.watchlist: The anticipation list: quiet names inside established momentum, the top five with a buy-stop plan each, the rest also quiet.
_contract.open_plans: Every pick from the last five sessions judged from bars alone, with the instruction for tomorrow. If you never bought it, ignore the row.
_contract.scorecard: The rules' record from bars alone: plans, fills, wins, losses, win rate, average and summed R, and SPY over the same days. Read only from min_read plans; it measures the rules, not your fills.
_contract.closest_miss: On a night with no trade: the best burst that did not qualify and, in one sentence, why.
